claims.claim: Preserve exactly the TASK-123 public API surface, public dataclass fields, builder/renderer signatures, and canonical RAG schema version 1.
A canonically valid context renders byte-for-byte the same deterministic compact JSON after TASK-124 under the same values and byte budget.
Supplemental packing decides byte-budget rejection independently from render/integrity failure without swallowing CanonicalRagContextError or parsing exception messages.
A retrieval hit whose eligible supplemental evidence contains a naive observed_at fails construction with CanonicalRagContextError rather than returning truncated=true.
A non-renderable supplemental block fails closed even when its serialized content would also exceed the remaining byte budget.
Timezone-aware observed_at values canonicalize to UTC and value-equal instants with different offsets produce identical rendered JSON.
Valid oversized supplemental evidence remains omitted whole in canonical order with exact truncated and omitted_evidence_blocks metadata.
Mandatory context overflow remains fail-closed, retrieval witnesses remain mandatory, and TASK-122 delegation occurs exactly once.
Exact hit, profile, witness, and source-evidence identity reuse, conflict plurality, whitelist, citation addressing, and evidence_policy remain unchanged.
Regressions cover packing integrity hardening, invalid/oversized failures, UTC determinism, and no-model/no-I/O behavior; documentation records TASK-124 as packing integrity hardening only.
